warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Page canvas, base surface — replaces pure white to give the interface a paper-like warmth

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, product UI panels, elevated content blocks

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, dark section background, filled nav button, high-contrast borders

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Section dividers, subtle alternating surfaces, input field backgrounds

pebble-border.$description: Pebble Border — Hairline borders on cards, dividers between sections, table separators

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, muted body copy, supporting labels

mid-gray.$description: Mid Gray — Tertiary text, icon strokes, disabled states, caption metadata

muted-ash.$description: Muted Ash — Placeholder text, subtle borders, low-emphasis text

warm-gold.$description: Warm Gold — Primary CTA buttons, active state highlights — the amber pencil-mark accent that makes the single action feel warm and inviting rather than corporate

deep-amber.$description: Deep Amber — Orange decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

burnt-honey.$description: Burnt Honey — Yellow decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

storyboard-blue.$description: Storyboard Blue — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis

sketch-blue.$description: Sketch Blue — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces

matter.$description: Primary typeface — custom geometric sans-serif with friendly proportions, used across all UI, body, and display contexts. Weight 400–500 for body and UI, 600–700 for headings and emphasis.

ui-monospace.$description: System monospace for code blocks, API endpoint paths, and technical metadata in the dark developer section
